inv.location: Calle de Rafael Ceballos, 3, Ventilla-Almenara, Tetuán, Madrid
features: Commercial activity: Electronics and computer shop
inv.desc_es:
Local con una excelente ubicación, a solo 5 minutos a pie de Plaza de Castilla.

El local dispone de acceso directo desde la calle. Su distribución actual incluye dos salas, una zona con desagües, un aseo y un baño completo con ducha y caldera, ofreciendo una base funcional y versátil para adaptarlo a distintos proyectos.

Por su ubicación, tamaño y adaptación, representa una interesante oportunidad para compradores e inversores que busquen adquirir un activo en una zona consolidada de Madrid y que quieran montar su negocio en esta zona tan céntrica llena de posibilidades.
inv.desc_en:
Premises with an excellent location, on a quiet street, just a 5-minute walk from Plaza de Castilla.

The premises have direct access from the street. Their current layout includes two rooms, an area with plumbing, a half bathroom, and a full bathroom with a shower and boiler, offering a functional and versatile base to adapt to different projects.

Located on a quiet, residential street, yet surrounded by shops, services, and amenities, it combines the comfort of a stable environment with proximity to one of the capital's main transport hubs. There are bus and Metro stops just a few minutes' walk away.

Due to its location, size, and potential for adaptation, it represents an interesting opportunity for buyers and investors looking to acquire an asset in a consolidated area of Madrid.
